item.title: The Case of the Printer Nobody Could Reach
item.description: My iPhone could see my home printer, but it hadn't printed a page in 127 days. Here's how I tracked down why, what finally fixed it, and how to check your own setup when AirPrint goes quiet.

item.title: AirPrint for a Printer That Never Had It
item.description: My Epson L3250 doesn't support AirPrint, so my iPhone can't see it. One small container on my Synology NAS fixes that. Here's how it works, and how to set it up for your own printer.
